quality_check.description: A single 9:16-style vertical screen-printed atlas card is visible, with a worn soot-black outer edge, bone-white margin, inset illustration window, coarse grain, and distressed corners. Inside, a pale sheet or veil covered in thin blue-gray forecast-like lines tears diagonally across the composition, revealing a jagged vermilion rupture with dense black shadowing beneath. Additional thin technical geometry breaks around the anomaly, and the illustrated texture continues through the full usable height with no caption field, text, host, grid, or multiple panels.
violations: The vermilion anomaly is exposed as a large multi-lobed burst rather than being mostly concealed with only one sharp jagged fragment visible at the torn edge.
The forecast lines on the veil are predominantly flowing and wavy rather than strongly orderly, smooth, and precise, which weakens the contrast between retrospective order and underlying shock.
Leftward sliding motion of the veil is not clearly communicated by the visible composition.
A distinct restrained oxidized-teal accent is not clearly evident; the secondary linework reads primarily as muted blue-gray.

The veil should conceal most of an irregular vermilion burst, leaving only one sharp jagged fragment exposed at the torn edge, making retrospective order visibly mask the original shock. Use bone white and pale stone grounds, dense soot black, muted storm blue-gray and restrained oxidized teal, with vermilion only for the hidden anomaly; broad matte light fields and deep graphic ink shadows, bold silhouettes, crisp contours with occasional dry-ink breaks, and thin technical geometry that fractures near the anomaly. Fill the full illustration height naturally—no caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel, or low-detail lower band. No storyboard, grid, collage or multiple panels. Diagrams, environments, swans, tools, markets, and technology scenes all remain inside this repeated print-window grammar, with the border thickness and inner margins held consistent throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it.
